label: Fires at GO after an a2 -> S2 rewarded trial, only in mid-to-late episode (trials 40-89).
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - last_is("a2 S2 r")) * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8])
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - last_is("a2 S2 r")) * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_dec == 6) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_dec == 7) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_dec == 4)
explanation: GO-only feature (zero at D1 and D2). Its magnitude is an interaction of the previous trial and episode time: about +0.24 at GO when the last trial was a2 -> S2 rewarded (the a2-common-rewarded pattern, model-based stay-on-a2 evidence) and the episode is in trials 40-89; otherwise about zero, so the additive timing baseline over-predicts every other previous-trial pattern in that window (the second term corrects this). It is near zero before trial ~30 and in the last decile even after a2 S2 r. Belief log-odds adds nothing once the last-trial pattern is in (belief deciles toward S2 only look predictive because they track a2 S2 r). The free fit adds a finer per-decile ramp (strongest at deciles 6-7, weaker at 4) and a small boost when the trial before also reached S2 rewarded (a run of a2 S2 r). Remaining misses: some a2 S2 r trials late in the episode where the feature stays silent with no visible observed cause.

terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * isin(ep_dec, [4,5,6,7,8]) * belief_lo

issues: Main systematic miss: GO on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial falls outside the window so last_is() returns 0 ('GO after ?' under-predicted by +0.047). Adding (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * isin(ep_dec,[4..8]) raises test R^2 from 0.51 to 0.58. That gain comes from how the windows are cut, not from the agent; the agent knows its own history.

An observed-only stand-in for those window-start cases, (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief_lo < -1), only raises test R^2 to 0.54 and causes over-prediction after a2 S1 r (-0.037). It is not worth adopting, so the recorded short form stands.

The fitted magnitude after a2 S2 r is too low within the window. The worst misses are a2 S2 r streaks at trials 76-84 with actual ~0.60 and predicted ~0.35, which matches the ramp toward deciles 6-7 that the explanation mentions. Adding isin(ep_dec,[6,7]) gives test R^2 0.55, a modest gain.
'Belief adds nothing' is roughly right. A belief_lo < -2 term restricted to the window adds only +0.02 (test 0.53).

Claims checked out. Removing the window restriction from the a2 S2 r term drops test R^2 to 0.34, so the trials 40-89 window is real. The timing baseline is ~0 at D1, D2, deciles 0-3 and decile 9. a1 S2 r residual (-0.048) looks like the other non-a2-S2-r patterns, and an a1 S2 r term adds nothing (0.52). The trial-before-rewarded term adds nothing (0.517). The second term is a fair correction (other patterns in the window are near zero) and is not disguised curve fitting.
